title.value: On the Morality of Artificial Intelligence
title.justification: The paper's title is 'On the Morality of Artificial Intelligence' as stated clearly in the document.
title.quote: On the Morality of Artificial Intelligence

analysis.description: This paper discusses the social and ethical impact of Artificial Intelligence (AI), emphasizing the importance of Machine Learning (ML) practitioners considering ethics and moral values in their work. It provides conceptual and practical principles for ethical ML research and deployment, promoting the use of AI for social good.

type.justification: The paper primarily discusses ethical frameworks, guidelines, and theoretical principles regarding AI's social impact and morality, rather than presenting empirical data or experiments.
type.quote: In the present article, which is specifically aimed at ML practitioners, we thus focus more on the latter, carrying out an overview of existing high-level ethical frameworks and guidelines, but above all proposing both conceptual and practical principles and guidelines for ML research and deployment.

name.justification: The paper focuses on the ethical and moral aspects of AI technology, specifically addressing ethical guidelines, moral considerations, and the impact of AI.
name.quote: Much of the existing research on the social and ethical impact of Artificial Intelligence has been focused on defining ethical principles and guidelines surrounding Machine Learning (ML) and other Artificial Intelligence (AI) algorithms.

name.justification: The paper discusses the role of ML in ethical considerations and its implications for AI.
name.quote: ...proposing both conceptual and practical principles and guidelines for ML research and deployment, insisting on concrete actions that can be taken by practitioners to pursue a more ethical and moral practice of ML aimed at using AI for social good.

name.justification: Computer vision is mentioned in the context of its use in surveillance and facial recognition, highlighting ethical concerns associated with these technologies.
name.quote: ...facial recognition algorithms have been found to underperform on gender and racial minorities [Buolamwini and Gebru, 2018].

name.justification: The paper discusses issues related to gender bias in word embeddings, a topic within natural language processing.
name.quote: A similar type of gender bias was also found in pretrained word embedding models...

name.justification: The paper mentions GANs in the context of generating fake images and sounds, which is a key characteristic of the model.
name.quote: Thanks to rapid progress in generative neural networks such as the GANs [Goodfellow et al., 2014], it is becoming possible to synthesize images and sounds in a controlled way...

is_contributed.justification: GANs are mentioned as an existing technology relevant to ethical discussions, not as a novel contribution of this paper.
is_contributed.quote: Thanks to rapid progress in generative neural networks such as the GANs [Goodfellow et al., 2014]...

is_executed.justification: The paper does not describe any execution or application of GANs within its own work, only their theoretical implications.
is_executed.quote: GANs are not executed or discussed in terms of implementation in this paper.

is_compared.justification: The paper discusses GANs in the context of ethical issues but does not compare them numerically to other models.
is_compared.quote: Generative adversarial networks such as the GANs...are not compared numerically in this paper.

referenced_paper_title.justification: The reference to GANs includes the citation of the foundational paper by Goodfellow et al., which introduced them.
referenced_paper_title.quote: Generative adversarial nets. In Advances in neural information processing systems, pages 2672–2680, 2014.

name.justification: The paper references MNIST as a common dataset used to benchmark ML algorithms before the focus on ethical impacts became prevalent.
name.quote: ...an object recognition algorithm could be tested on a common dataset like MNIST [LeCun et al., 1998]...

referenced_paper_title.value: Gradient-based learning applied to document recognition
referenced_paper_title.justification: The dataset is referenced in historical context, citing its importance in ML research development.

name.justification: ImageNet is mentioned as an example of a dataset used to evaluate ML algorithms now facing real-world deployment impacts.
name.quote: ...or ImageNet [Deng et al., 2009], and an objective performance metric would be obtained in order to measure progress...

referenced_paper_title.value: Imagenet: A large-scale hierarchical image database
referenced_paper_title.justification: The dataset is cited to show its foundational role in computer vision research and biases identification.
referenced_paper_title.quote: Imagenet: A large-scale hierarchical image database.

name.justification: The What-If Tool is mentioned as a tool for practitioners to visualize data and test ML model performance.
name.quote: ...a tool called ‘What-If’, an open-source application that lets practitioners not only visualize their data, but also test the performance of their ML model in hypothetical situations...

referenced_paper_title.value: The what-if tool: Interactive probing of machine learning models
referenced_paper_title.justification: The library is introduced by citing the paper where the tool was extensively discussed in context.
referenced_paper_title.quote: The what-if tool: Interactive probing of machine learning models.
